title: A session returning to a held claim, or switching focus between held claims, must get a confirmed opening with no agent action and no Engram wait at opening
outcome: After a later claim ends and focus returns to a held claim whose root is still validly named, or focus moves between two held claims, the next turn's source root is confirmed automatically; opening stays local, and genuine mismatches stay unconfirmed.
acceptance: After a later claim ends and focus returns to a held claim whose root is still validly named, or focus moves between two held claims, the session's opening becomes confirmed with no agent action, through a future-only refresh from the closing read. A turn opened before that refresh settles stays unconfirmed; the documentation states that such a turn loses source attribution and its comparison baseline, and that no fixed number of turns is promised. A genuinely different root, stale generation, unresolved authority or other existing refusal remains unconfirmed. Turn opening does not wait on Engram.
